title: Medium Vase
body:
"A great spot to put your flowers! Can be dyed with a Dye Machine."

Description

The Medium Vase is a decoration item bought from Flora Laura for $480. The vase is a circular object that can be placed either way on the vertical axis. The mesh used for the vase has both the top and bottom exhibit a hole. The default color is a sandy-grey hue.

This vase, like its counterparts (Small Vase, Large Vase) can be dyed using flowers.

As of right now, players cannot put flowers in a vase. However, decoration using schematics is possible. Make sure to anchor the vase first.

Obtaining

Players can obtain the Medium Vase by purchasing it with cash for $480 at Flora Laura, located in Flowering Meadows.
